title: lib-probe
purpose: Proves a user capability can import and CALL an external library at runtime (E8), and that a compileOnly dependency is correctly ABSENT from the runtime classpath.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo. Driven by scripts/quality/run-library-probe.py in CI.
The assertion is the RETURNED VALUE, not that it compiled.
expectedOutcomes: SignWithLibrary returns Guava's SHA-256 of a known input, matching the known digest.
ProbeCompileOnlyAtRuntime reports the compileOnly class as ABSENT at runtime.
